name: cli_temp_in
desc: interior temperature: the hotter of the two levels
notes: what the cooling ladder controls on; the spec keeps the worst case between levels, and the gap between them is cli_dTStrat_degC

name: cli_temp_hi
notes: median of the three probes, then EWMA

name: cli_rh_hi
desc: ceiling relative humidity, voted and filtered
notes: fraction 0..1; median of three, then EWMA

name: cli_temp_lo
notes: median of the three probes, then EWMA

name: cli_rh_lo
desc: floor relative humidity, voted and filtered
notes: fraction 0..1; median of three, then EWMA

name: cli_temp_cs
notes: median of the three probes, then EWMA

name: cli_rh_cs
desc: crawlspace relative humidity, voted and filtered
notes: fraction 0..1; median of three, then EWMA

name: cli_temp_ext
notes: median of the three probes, then EWMA

name: cli_rh_ext
desc: exterior relative humidity, voted and filtered
notes: fraction 0..1; median of three, then EWMA

name: cli_dTStrat_degC
notes: what the destratification ladder reads

name: cli_dewPoint_degC
notes: the worse of the two interior levels

name: cli_dpMargin_degC
desc: interior dew-point margin: how far from condensing
notes: larger is drier; what the rot ladder is set in

name: cli_vpd_kPa
notes: larger is thirstier; what irrigation is modulated on

name: cli_targetTemp_degC
desc: cooling target in force for the current phase
notes: the bank phases offset it, then it is clamped 14..27

name: cli_prevDayMax_degC
desc: highest interior temperature of the previous day
notes: gates COLD_BANK: pre-cool only after a hot day

name: cli_prevNightMin_degC
desc: lowest interior temperature of the previous night
notes: gates HEAT_BANK: bank heat only after a cold night

name: cli_coolDem
notes: PID on the interior temperature against cli_targetTemp_degC

name: cli_stratDem
notes: 3-band hysteresis on cli_dTStrat_degC; the default is the low band, which is what an unknown gap must fall back to

name: cli_fanSpeed
desc: destratification fan speed in force, 0 to 3
notes: the band the fans are actually in; the three coils are one relay each

name: cli_windowDem
desc: how far the cooling ladder wants the windows open
notes: 0..1, before the rain, wind and supply interlocks; cli_windowN_tgt is where each one is actually going

name: cli_humidDem
notes: 4 bands and a dead zone on cli_dpMargin_degC

name: cli_coldBankArm
desc: cold banking armed for the coming dawn
notes: yesterday ran hotter than cli_coldBankTrg_degC

name: cli_heatBankArm
desc: heat banking armed for the coming dusk
notes: last night ran colder than cli_heatBankTrg_degC

name: irr_inFlow_Lpm
desc: inlet flow, differentiated from the counter
notes: one pulse is irr_input_qtyPerImp litres, so the rate is a window average

name: irr_inTotal_L
desc: inlet water counter, since it was last zeroed
notes: retained: the value IS the history, and a reboot must not zero the meter

name: irr_outTotal_L
desc: outlet water counter, since it was last zeroed
notes: integrated from irr_outFlow_Lpm; there is no outlet pulse train

name: irr_vpdAvg_kPa
desc: dryness tracker: VPD averaged over irr_dryEwmaDays
notes: folded once an HOUR; per scan the increment underflows, per day the result depends on the hour it was taken

name: irr_mod
notes: scales volume and period so total flow tracks it

name: irr_period_days
desc: modulated interval, for the tray due next
notes: the tray's summer period divided by mod^(1-volFreqSplit)

name: irr_volume_L
desc: modulated dose, for the tray being served
notes: the tray's summer volume times mod^volFreqSplit

name: irr_today
desc: the day the schedule is running against, 0 before the clock is set
notes: read back, so forcing it rehearses a date - or a plant that has never had one

name: irr_servedToday
desc: trays served since the day rolled over
notes: capped by irr_traysPerDay; the surplus waits for tomorrow

name: irr_delivered_L
desc: delivered into the tray being filled
notes: counted off irr_inPulse, one pulse per irr_input_qtyPerImp

name: irr_drained_L
desc: drained back out of the tray being served
notes: integrated off irr_out_Lpm over the drain window

name: irr_outFlow_Lpm
notes: what the drain verdict integrates

notes: what the arbitration asked for

notes: estimated from travel time; only a seating stroke proves 0

name: cli_windLockout
notes: gusting over cli_windShutEnd_mps

name: cli_windowLockout
desc: the roof is held shut, whatever the ladder wants
notes: stage one of the arbitration: rain, wind or the supply. Force it to hold the roof shut by hand

name: cli_windowCap
desc: the most the roof may open
notes: 0 shuts it; the wind band ramps it down to 0 at cli_windShutEnd_mps

name: cli_wind_mps
notes: the WORSE of the stations: two cannot say which one is lying, and an interlock errs toward shutting

name: cli_windGust_mps
notes: the worse of the stations, like the mean beside it

name: cli_rain_mmph
notes: the WETTER of the stations: a shower one gauge misses still shuts the roof

name: cli_irrad_Wpm2
notes: the MEAN: nothing controls on it, so the worst case has no meaning here

name: cli_sinceRain_min
desc: minutes since the gauge last read wet
notes: held until the first shower of this run: a reboot does not know when it last rained

name: cli_screenMoving
notes: cuts the destratification fans while it moves

name: cli_rotLockout
notes: cuts the skirt valve whatever the humidity demand

name: cli_rotVentDem
notes: one of the three the intractors take the max of

name: cli_skirtDuty
notes: of cli_skirtPeriod_sec; under cli_skirtMinOn_sec it stays off

name: cli_intakeCoolOk
desc: intake air is cool enough to be worth drawing
notes: crawlspace is cli_ventTempMgn_degC under the interior

name: cli_groundHeatOk
desc: intake air is warm enough to be worth drawing
notes: the mirror gate: the ground is that much OVER the interior, and the ladder is asking for heat

name: cli_intakeDryOk
desc: outside air is dry enough to be worth drawing
notes: exterior dew point is cli_ventDryMgn_degC under the interior's

name: irr_dueTray
desc: tray owed water now, 0 when none is
notes: the schedule's answer: the most overdue tray whose interval has elapsed, or a forced one

name: irr_slotOpen
desc: the climate allows a cycle to start
notes: end of night once the plants are warm enough, or the morning window
